note: Additional usage tiers computed after feedback that the original single 324-sessions/day fleet projection was not relatable to most readers. Uses the same measured per-session token shape as model-projections.json, priced at Claude Sonnet 5 standard rate ($3/$3.75/$0.30/$15 per MTok base/5m-write/read/output) for a representative middle-tier model. Other models scale by their base-price ratio to Sonnet (Haiku ~0.33x, Opus ~1.67x, Fable ~3.33x), since the reduction ratio itself is model-invariant (verified: ~8.2x across all models in model-projections.json).
